Admission for US Applicants
To be considered for admission as a regular degree student to the graduate program at the Department of Mathematics, University of Colorado, Colorado Springs please Apply Online.
The following will be requested in the process.
A $60.00 non-refundable application fee
An official transcript from each college/university attended, sent directly from the previous school or hand delivered in a sealed university envelope (UCCS Transcript Request Form)
Letters of recommendation from faculty at colleges/universities attended: 2 for the M.S. and MSc programs, and 3 for the Ph.D. program
Scores from the GRE General Test, taken within the last 2 years (for Spring 2022 or later admission)
An In-State Tuition Classification Form, if claiming in-state tuition eligibility
Students who wish to request financial assistance from the department should also submit an application for a Graduate Teaching Fellowship, directly to the department, at the address below.
Completed applications (including all supporting documentation) should be submitted 60 days prior to the term for which admission is sought. However, applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and will be considered if this deadline is not met.
Information
Additional information can be found on the UCCS Graduate School page. Please contact the Mathematics Graduate Chair with any questions.

Admission for International Applicants
To be considered for admission as a regular degree student to the graduate program at the Department of Mathematics, University of Colorado, Colorado Springs please Apply Online.
The following will be requested in the process.
A Financial Statement for International Students Form, with the required documentation
A $60.00 non-refundable application fee
An official transcript from each college/university attended. Applicants with course-work from any foreign college must submit a course-by-course foreign transcript evaluation by a NACES or AICE member. (Please note: Official evaluations received directly from SpanTran, WES and ECE credential agencies may enable more efficient review and processing of transfer credit by UCCS.)
Letters of recommendation from faculty at colleges/universities attended: 2 for the M.S. and MSc programs, and 3 for the Ph.D. program
Scores from the GRE General Test, taken within the last 2 years (for Spring 2022 or later admission)
Demonstration of English proficiency, for students whose native language is not English (Conditional acceptance will NOT be granted for students who do not meet the English language requirements set forth by the university and department.)
Students who wish to request financial assistance from the department should also submit an application for a Graduate Teaching Fellowship, directly to the department, at the address below.
Completed applications (including all supporting documentation) should be submitted 60 days prior to the term for which admission is sought. However, applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and will be considered if this deadline is not met.
Information
Additional information can be found on the UCCS Graduate School page. Please contact the UCCS Office of International Affairs (OIA) with any questions.

ATTN: Graduate Liaison

Outstanding UCCS Students
Streamlined Admission for Outstanding UCCS Students
The Mathematics Department offers guaranteed and expedited admission to the department's graduate program to current UCCS students who satisfy the following conditions.
Are in the process of completing the Mathematics B.S. degree at UCCS.
Are in their final undergraduate semester.
Have an overall GPA of at least 3.5, as well as a MATH GPA of at least 3.5.
Are residents of the United States.
Interested students should Apply Online.
The following will be requested in the process.
A $60.00 non-refundable application fee
Two letters of recommendation from members of the mathematics department faculty
Submit regular graduate application, GRE scores not required
Email the Graduate Chair and Graduate School to inform them that you are applying for streamlined admission.
Students who wish to request financial assistance from the department should also submit an application for a Graduate Teaching Fellowship, directly to the department, at the address below.
Completed applications (including all supporting documentation) should be submitted 60 days prior to the term for which admission is sought. However, applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and will be considered if this deadline is not met.
Information
Additional information can be found on the UCCS Graduate School page. Please contact the Mathematics Graduate Chair with any questions.
